text: なにか…　ポケモンマニア　という　えらい　ひとと　しりあいだとか　マゴが　さわいで　おった　わしには　よう　わからんが　ニシキくんは　えらい！

structure.jp: なにか…　ポケモンマニア　という　えらい　ひとと　しりあいだとか
structure.en: something about him knowing some great person called a PokéManiac

structure.jp: マゴが　さわいで　おった
structure.en: my grandchild was making a fuss

structure.jp: わしには　よう　わからんが
structure.en: I don't really understand it, but

structure.jp: ニシキくんは　えらい！

patterns.name: 〜とか
patterns.explanation: とか after a statement passes on something you heard without being sure of it. しりあいだとか = 'something about him being an acquaintance'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: おった is the old-man form of いた, so this is 〜ていた, something that was going on. さわいで　おった = 'was making a fuss'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が after a finished statement means 'but'. わからん is the old-man form of わからない. わからんが = 'I don't understand, but'.
